lines.text: When the LORD restores Judah, He will bring all the nations down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat for judgment.
The LORD charges Tyre, Sidon and Philistia with taking His treasures and selling Judah's people to the Egyptians.
The LORD will sell their sons and daughters to the people of Judah, who will sell them to the Sabeans.
The nations must beat plowshares into swords and advance to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, where the LORD will judge.
A spring will flow from the LORD's house to water the Valley of Acacias, while Egypt and Moab become desolate.
